property_summary: The reference contract allows a non-owner to call transferOwnership because the onlyOwner modifier uses require(msg.sender == owner), which correctly ensures only the owner can call it; the second version has a bug where require(msg.sender != owner) allows any non-owner to call transferOwnership, so after deploy, owner is address(0), and a call from any EOA (e.g., address(1)) reverts in the reference (fails assertion) but succeeds in the buggy version (passes assertion).
